## harness init

Create .harness/project.yaml for a repository, using the detected technology profiles.

```text
harness init [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--force` | flag | no | false | Replace an existing project configuration |

## harness inspect

Detect the technology profiles of a repository (read-only), with confidence and
evidence.

```text
harness inspect [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no | --json | Print JSON (default) or a plain representation |

## harness doctor

Check the local environment (Python and Git required; Node.js and npm reported as
NOT_APPLICABLE when absent) and, with --path, the project configuration. Exit code 2 when a
required check fails.

```text
harness doctor [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | path | no |  | Also validate the project in this directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no | --json | Print JSON (default) or a plain representation |

## harness status

Show the full status projection of a run: phases, validations, findings, gate, human
decision, event-chain check and metrics.

```text
harness status [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | yes |  | Run (execution) identifier |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no | --json | Print JSON (default) or a plain representation |

## harness trace

Export the trace of a run as Markdown, JSON, JSONL or SARIF.

```text
harness trace [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | yes |  | Run (execution) identifier |
| `--format` | str | no | `markdown` | markdown, json, jsonl or sarif |
| `--output` | path | no |  | Write to this file instead of standard output |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness retrospect


| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | yes |  | Run (execution) identifier |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness run start

Create a run for a task and execute the normative phases until a stop condition. Exit
code 4 means the automated phases finished and a human decision is pending; 6 means a
validation, policy or blocking condition stopped the run.

```text
harness run start [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--task` | str | yes |  | Task identifier (taskId) |
| `--provider` | str | no |  | Agent provider id; defaults to the project agentProvider |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no | --json | Print JSON (default) or a plain representation |

## harness run continue

Resume a run from its persisted state, for example after fixing the environment or after
REQUEST_CHANGES.

```text
harness run continue [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | yes |  | Run (execution) identifier |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no | --json | Print JSON (default) or a plain representation |

## harness run cancel

Cancel a run and terminate its active process group. The cancellation is recorded as an
event.

```text
harness run cancel [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | yes |  | Run (execution) identifier |
| `--actor` | str | no | `human.local` | Identifier of the person acting (recorded, not authenticated) |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness gate decide

Record a human decision bound to the current ChangeSet digest. A decision for a stale
digest, or APPROVE over a gate that did not pass, is rejected with exit code 5.

```text
harness gate decide [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | yes |  | Run (execution) identifier |
| `--decision` | `APPROVE` \| `REJECT` \| `REQUEST_CHANGES` \| `APPROVE_EXCEPTION` | yes |  | Human decision |
| `--change-set-digest` | str | yes |  | Current ChangeSet digest shown by status (sha256:...) |
| `--rationale` | str | yes |  | Justification recorded with the decision |
| `--actor` | str | no | `human.local` | Identifier of the person acting (recorded, not authenticated) |
| `--continue`, `--no-continue` | flag | no | --continue | Resume the run after recording the decision |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness memory add

Record a memory entry with its provenance. NORMATIVE, PROJECT and RETROSPECTIVE entries
enter a context only once approved.

```text
harness memory add [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--level` | `NORMATIVE` \| `PROJECT` \| `TASK` \| `EPHEMERAL` \| `RETROSPECTIVE` | yes |  | Scope of the record |
| `--key` | str | yes |  | Stable name of the record within its level |
| `--value` | str | yes |  | JSON object, or plain text stored under the key 'text' |
| `--task` | str | no |  | Task identifier; required for TASK |
| `--run` | str | no |  | Run identifier; required for EPHEMERAL |
| `--valid-until` | str | no |  | ISO 8601 instant after which the record no longer applies |
| `--supersedes` | str | no |  | Identifier of the record this one replaces |
| `--sensitive` | flag | no | false | Withhold the value from the context manifest and the agent |
| `--approve` | flag | no | false | Record the entry as approved by the acting person |
| `--actor` | str | no | `human.local` | Identifier of the person acting (recorded, not authenticated) |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness memory approve

Approve a proposed record. The approval is a new record that supersedes the proposal;
approving a record that needs no approval or is already approved exits with code 5.

```text
harness memory approve [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--memory` | str | yes |  | Memory record identifier |
| `--actor` | str | no | `human.local` | Identifier of the person acting (recorded, not authenticated) |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness memory invalidate

Invalidate a record without deleting it: it stops entering any context and the actor and
the reason stay on record.

```text
harness memory invalidate [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--memory` | str | yes |  | Memory record identifier |
| `--reason` | str | yes |  | Why the record no longer applies |
| `--actor` | str | no | `human.local` | Identifier of the person acting (recorded, not authenticated) |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

|---|---|---|---|---|

## harness recommendation decide

Accept, edit or reject a retrospective recommendation. The decision is kept as
retrospective memory: an accepted or edited recommendation enters the context of later
runs, a rejected one stays as history. A second decision on the same recommendation exits
with code 5; nothing is applied to rules, gates or configuration.

```text
harness recommendation decide [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | yes |  | Run (execution) identifier |
| `--recommendation` | str | yes |  | Recommendation identifier shown by retrospect |
| `--decision` | `ACCEPT` \| `EDIT` \| `REJECT` | yes |  | Decision on the recommendation |
| `--rationale` | str | yes |  | Justification recorded with the decision |
| `--statement` | str | no |  | Edited text of the recommendation; required with EDIT |
| `--actor` | str | no | `human.local` | Identifier of the person acting (recorded, not authenticated) |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness benchmark run

Run the synthetic microbenchmarks (hashing, transitions, gates, events, artifacts,
process launch).

```text

```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--output` | path | no |  | Write to this file instead of standard output |
| `--iterations` | int range | no | `1000` | Iterations per in-process operation |

## harness benchmark scenarios

Compare a direct patch-and-test path with the complete governed path on generated Python
and Node.js projects.

```text
harness benchmark scenarios [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--output` | path | no |  | Write to this file instead of standard output |
| `--iterations` | int range | no | `3` | Repetitions per scenario |

## harness api serve

Serve the local API and web dashboard. There is no authentication: keep it bound to
127.0.0.1.

```text
harness api serve [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--host` | str | no | `127.0.0.1` | Bind address; keep the loopback default |
| `--port` | int range | no | `8765` | TCP port |
